stories.title: Student protests in Tirana turn violent, targeting government buildings
stories.summary: Thousands of students marched in Tirana on the second day of anti‑government protests, beginning outside the Ministry of Education. Protesters set fire to part of the education ministry building and also attacked the prime minister’s office, finance and interior ministries and nearby businesses, with some wearing gas masks and balaclavas and throwing rocks and firecrackers. Deputy Prime Minister Albana Koçiu urged calm and said Albania does not need to burn to change.
stories.why: The unrest shows deep dissatisfaction with university conditions and job prospects, raising the risk of wider political instability.

stories.title: US inflation rises more than expected
stories.summary: US inflation rose by more than expected in the year to September, according to official figures, in the final data release before the midterm elections next month. For example, if a bottle of milk costs $1 but rises to $1.10 a year later, then annual inflation for bottled milk is 10%.
stories.why: This matters because it can affect economic growth, prices, employment, borrowing costs or trade decisions.

stories.title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence
stories.summary: The company says its fleet of agents has so far wasted 17 years of scammers’ time across 2.5 million conversations. The FBI received more than 22,000 complaints of AI-related crimes in 2025, which resulted in about $893 million in losses.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.

stories.title: WPI inflation quickens to 11.39% in September from 9.9% in August
stories.summary: Wholesale prices in India rose significantly to 11.39% in September, driven by rising fuel and food costs. Retail inflation also increased to 5.54%, attributed largely to higher vegetable prices.
stories.why: This matters because it can affect economic growth, prices, employment, borrowing costs or trade decisions.

stories.title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
stories.summary: YouTube said it collaborated with various music partners and deployed its own detection tools to identify AI-generated music. The move comes as AI-generated music rapidly expands across streaming services, and many platforms are adopting their own approaches.For instance, Apple Music has plans to introduce “Made With AI” labels as part of its AI Transparency Tags later this year.

stories.title: Floqer’s AI agents research sales prospects so teams don’t have to
stories.summary: Floqer is an autonomous customer knowledge platform that provides business-to-business sales and marketing teams with an AI-powered database designed to continuously collect, organize, and update the information used to understand their customers. Floqer also says it has surpassed $1.2 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR), and that its overall revenue has grown roughly tenfold over the past year.
